changelog:
Sending to a television notices when the television has ended it.

WHAT CHANGED

- If a television unpairs itself, or the pairing server closes the
  phone's connection, the phone now notices straight away. Before, it
  could go on showing "Send to" your television while nothing it sent
  arrived; now it goes back to offering to pair, or reconnects if the
  pairing is still good.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including 0.3.4's recovery from dropped streams and
  the LIVE button.
